skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of financial theory including monetary systems, financial markets, and government budgets.
Analyze different economic systems and their impact on financial policies.
Develop a basic understanding of national budgeting processes and their implications on financial institutions.
Apply fundamental principles of corporate finance to real-world scenarios.
Evaluate creditworthiness and assess risks associated with lending activities.
Comprehend the role of interest rates in financial markets and economic policy.
Conduct market analysis to understand trends and dynamics in financial markets.
